before: Most readers skipped decimal twips values, so tab stops, grid widths, indents and page geometry with a decimal value read as absent. Tab stop edits carried a decimal stop through unchanged.
after: Decimal and unit-suffixed twips values read as whole twips. Tab stop and table edits that rewrite such a value write the whole number.
reason: Shared operations and the stored format are unchanged. Edits write integer twips, which released participants already read. Reading a decimal value changes only the local layout projection.
